item.title: The Immortal Science: Preface to the French Translation of “Forest and Factory”
item.description: Thanks to the hard work of our friends at Sans Soleil, “Forest and Factory: The Science and the Fiction of Communism” has been translated into French. This edition includes a new preface that coauthor Phil A. Neel and I wrote together, which is reproduced in English below. item.title: Red May 2023: We Have Never Been Post-Industrial
item.description: I recently organized a panel talk with my friends and collaborators Wendy Liu, Phil Neel, and Anette Ramos. You can watch the archived talk and subsequent Q&A here. Special thanks to the Red May organizers for facilitating all of this.
